data.narrative:
Saronic is a Series D defense and security company founded by Mavrookas, Lehman, Altekar, and Lambert, valued at $9.25B post-money after raising $2.6B+. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 10 comparable companies—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private, including same-stage defense peers Helsing ($18.0B), Chaos Industries ($4.5B), and Onebrief ($2.1B).

Two primary methods triangulate the valuation. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x multiplier typical of Series D advancement, yielding $13.9B from the $9.2B base. Peer-median methodology examines three same-sector, same-stage comparables, producing a $4.5B median valuation with a range from $2.1B to $18.0B, reflecting substantial dispersion in the defense tech market. The peer set also includes private companies Anduril Industries and Shield AI at the upper bound of the landscape.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $3.8B (low) to $16.0B (high), with a median of $9.2B. The current post-money valuation of $9.25B sits near the calculated median, though material uncertainty reflects the wide peer dispersion ($2.1B–$18.0B). Key variables include stage advancement likelihood, relative product maturity versus Helsing, and market timing within the defense sector.
